stations.title: Campaign records
stations.guard: No specimen movement; logical access only
stations.qualification: Unbuilt contract; required card and physical inspection before use

stations.title: Identified inventory
stations.interface: Indexed trays, material labels and carrier supports
stations.guard: Keep fragile teeth/arms unloaded; quarantine uncertain lots
stations.qualification: Unbuilt contract; required card and physical inspection before use

stations.title: Interstation transport
stations.guard: Destination reservation, load restraint, untethered object, qualified collision route
stations.qualification: Unbuilt contract; required card and physical inspection before use

stations.title: Design qualification
stations.interface: Certified CAD/build-card and metrology record API
stations.guard: No geometry synthesized from inconsistent source dimensions
stations.qualification: Unbuilt contract; required card and physical inspection before use

stations.title: Qualified fabrication service
stations.interface: Enclosed machining/printing cartridge, plate and job interface
stations.guard: Approved service owns machining, resin processing and controlled postprocessing
stations.qualification: Unbuilt contract; required card and physical inspection before use

stations.title: Supported preparation
stations.interface: Baseplate nest, surrounding box jig and support-removal service dock
stations.guard: No unqualified peel force or solvent recipe; preserve gear registration
stations.qualification: Unbuilt contract; required card and physical inspection before use

stations.title: Constrained assembly
stations.interface: Part nests, shaft insertion fixture, supported frame, qualified torque/grasp tooling
stations.guard: Prevent tooth/arm loading and out-of-plane loss; insertion limits are input gates
stations.qualification: Unbuilt contract; required card and physical inspection before use

stations.title: Phase and geometry inspection
stations.interface: Microscope/camera, datum fixture and qualified angular indexing adapter
stations.guard: Measure actual polarity/angle; no label-only reconfiguration
stations.qualification: Unbuilt contract; required card and physical inspection before use

stations.title: Universal loading machine
stations.interface: Compression platen, tail clamps, shear guide or diagonal grooves
stations.guard: Fixture mode and calibration bind to specimen version; enclosed machine owns loading
stations.qualification: Unbuilt contract; required card and physical inspection before use

stations.title: Motor actuation station
stations.interface: Versioned coupler/electrical interfaces and phase imaging
stations.guard: De-energize for attachment; controller and wiring qualified before home/run
stations.qualification: Unbuilt contract; required card and physical inspection before use

stations.title: Guarded impact service
stations.interface: Approved enclosed drop-tower carrier dock and authoritative interlock API
stations.guard: Service exclusively owns mass handling/release/reset; general robot cannot arm or drop directly
stations.qualification: Unbuilt contract; required card and physical inspection before use

stations.title: In-situ observation
stations.guard: Logical observation at current mounted station; no specimen transport
stations.qualification: Unbuilt contract; required card and physical inspection before use

stations.title: Data analysis
stations.interface: Immutable raw artifacts and analysis-card API
stations.guard: Preserve measured, modeled and mock namespaces
stations.qualification: Unbuilt contract; required card and physical inspection before use

stations.title: Numerical study
stations.guard: No calculated curve replaces a physical acquisition
stations.qualification: Unbuilt contract; required card and physical inspection before use

stations.title: Cleanup and storage
stations.interface: Qualified cleaning/waste routes, recovered-parts tray and storage carrier
stations.guard: De-energize/unload before handling; no automatic reuse after impact
stations.qualification: Unbuilt contract; required card and physical inspection before use
